about.title: About The Fuel Pulse
about.subtitle: Real-time diesel, petrol 95, and petrol 98 prices across Latvia's major fuel networks — updated automatically, three times a day.
about.whatwedo.title: What We Do
about.whatwedo.p1: The Fuel Pulse tracks retail fuel prices at the pump across Latvia's four major fuel station chains — Circle K, Virši, Neste, and Viada. Prices are scraped directly from each retailer's public pricing pages and aggregated into a single dashboard.
about.whatwedo.p2: On top of raw prices, our AI analysis layer (powered by Google Gemini) reviews current global oil market news and issues a daily fill-up recommendation — buy now, wait, or monitor — with a plain-language explanation of the key price drivers.
about.methodology.title: Data Sources & Methodology
about.methodology.station: Station prices — scraped directly from each retailer's public-facing website, three times daily (08:00, 14:00, 20:00 Riga time).
about.methodology.news: Market news — aggregated from Google News RSS feeds filtered for Latvian and Baltic fuel market stories.
about.methodology.history: Historical data — stored as daily averages, enabling trend charts going back months.
about.methodology.ai: AI recommendation — generated by Google Gemini, which reads today's news headlines alongside current station prices to assess short-term price direction.
about.methodology.note: Prices reflect the rates publicly posted by each retailer and may differ slightly from the price you see at the pump due to local promotions or card discounts.
about.frequency.title: Update Frequency
about.frequency.p: Price data, market news, and AI recommendations are refreshed automatically at 08:00, 14:00, and 20:00 Riga time every day via a scheduled GitHub Actions pipeline. The timestamp shown on the dashboard always reflects the last completed data run.
about.trust.title: Why Trust This Data?
about.trust.p1: Unlike manually-maintained price comparison sites, The Fuel Pulse has no human editorial step between the retailer's website and what you see on screen. Our scraper reads prices from the same URLs you would visit yourself — there is no rounding, no delay, and no incentive to misrepresent figures.
about.trust.p2: Every data point is timestamped and the full price history is stored, so you can see exactly when prices changed and by how much. The AI recommendation clearly states its confidence level and cites the news sources it used — you are never asked to trust a black box.

about.disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
about.disclaimer.p: The Fuel Pulse provides publicly available pricing data for informational purposes only. We are not affiliated with any fuel retailer. Prices may vary by station location, loyalty programme, or payment method. We accept no liability for decisions made based on information presented on this site. The AI fill-up recommendation is an automated analysis of market trends and does not constitute financial advice.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.1.title: 1. Who We Are
privacy.1.p: This Privacy Policy applies to The Fuel Pulse, accessible at thefuelpulse.com. The site is operated as an independent fuel price information service covering Latvia. For privacy-related enquiries, contact us at info@thefuelpulse.com.
privacy.2.title: 2. Information We Collect
privacy.2.p1: The Fuel Pulse does not collect, store, or process any personally identifiable information. We do not have user accounts, registration forms, or comment systems.
privacy.2.p2: The only data processed on our servers is publicly available fuel price data scraped from retailer websites. No visitor data is retained on our infrastructure.
privacy.3.title: 3. Cookies
privacy.3.p1: We store one first-party preference cookie:
privacy.3.fueltheme: fuel-theme — stores your light/dark theme preference in localStorage. This never leaves your device and is not transmitted to any server.
privacy.3.p2: Third-party cookies may be set by Google AdSense (see Section 4). You can manage or block cookies through your browser settings or via Google's Ads Settings.
privacy.4.title: 4. Advertising — Google AdSense
privacy.4.p1: This site uses Google AdSense to display advertisements. Google AdSense is operated by Google LLC, 1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA 94043, USA.
privacy.4.p2: Google AdSense uses cookies and the DoubleClick cookie to serve ads based on your prior visits to this and other websites. These cookies allow Google and its partners to serve ads based on your visit to our site and/or other sites on the Internet.
privacy.4.p3: You may opt out of personalised advertising by visiting Google's Ads Settings or by visiting aboutads.info.
privacy.4.p4: For more information about how Google uses data when you use our site, see How Google uses data when you use our partners' sites or apps.
privacy.5.title: 5. Third-Party Links
privacy.5.p: Our news feed and AI recommendations may contain links to external websites. We have no control over the content or privacy practices of those sites and are not responsible for their policies. We recommend reading the privacy policy of any external site you visit.
privacy.6.title: 6. Data Transfers
privacy.6.p: This site is hosted on Cloudflare's global edge network. By visiting the site, your request may be routed through Cloudflare servers outside the European Economic Area. Cloudflare's privacy practices are governed by the Cloudflare Privacy Policy.
privacy.7.title: 7. Children's Privacy
privacy.7.p: This site is not directed at children under 13 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.
privacy.8.title: 8. Your Rights (GDPR)
privacy.8.p1: If you are located in the European Economic Area, you have the right to access, correct, or delete any personal data we hold about you. As we do not collect personal data, there is nothing to access or delete on our side.
privacy.8.p2: For questions about your rights or to exercise them regarding Google's data collection, contact Google directly or use their Data & Privacy settings.
privacy.9.title: 9. Changes to This Policy
privacy.9.p: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated date. Continued use of the site after any changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
privacy.10.title: 10. Contact
privacy.10.p: For privacy-related questions or concerns, email us at info@thefuelpulse.com.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.1.q: How often are fuel prices updated?
faq.1.a: Prices are scraped directly from each station's website three times daily — at 08:00, 14:00, and 20:00 Riga time. The timestamp on the dashboard reflects the last completed data run.
faq.2.q: What is the difference between DUS and ADUS?
faq.2.a: DUS is a full-service manned station with an operator on-site. ADUS is an unmanned automated station — self-service only, usually cheaper. Viada operates both types.
faq.3.q: What do E85, XTL, and HVO mean?
faq.3.a: E85 is a flex-fuel blend (85% ethanol, 15% petrol) — cheaper per litre but lower energy density, for compatible flex-fuel cars only. XTL is a synthetic diesel from Circle K. HVO (Hydrotreated Vegetable Oil) is Neste's renewable diesel — near-identical to fossil diesel but made from waste fats.
faq.4.q: Which station is usually cheapest for diesel in Latvia?
faq.4.a: Viada ADUS (unmanned) and Neste frequently offer diesel below the market average. Check the Station Comparison table above for today's live ranking.
faq.5.q: Is the AI fill-up recommendation reliable?
faq.5.a: The recommendation uses Google Gemini to analyse current oil market news alongside today's prices. It gives directional guidance (buy / wait / monitor) with a stated confidence level — not a guarantee. Always check the confidence level and cited sources before acting.
faq.6.q: Are station prices the same at every location in Latvia?
faq.6.a: The prices shown are national web prices published by each chain. Most Latvian chains maintain uniform pricing across all sites, but local promotions or loyalty card discounts may differ by location.
